integrity: Proof given for arbitrary allowed coprime indices; symbolic tests are finite corroboration, not substitutes for general proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the complex coprime family, normalization ramification, and the distinguished dual branch at infinity; other dual singularities and positive characteristic are unclassified. Historical priority and independent validation are outstanding.
title: Simple affine ramification and a cuspidal dual infinity for coprime Chebyshev curves
